pages.title: Curved Geometry
pages.text: $(thing)Curved Geometry$()$(br2)Drop the fifth postulate and parallel lines may meet, or spread apart: the geometry of a sphere, or of a saddle. Gauss measured mountain triangles to see which one we live in.

$(thing)Insight$(): 40$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Euclid's Elements, Cartography.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 π Crystal.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A triangle is drawn on a sphere of radius R and covers an area A. Write the sum S of its three angles.
